title: Beef Chili
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

items.raw: Namak (Salt) ¼ tsp or to taste
Safed mirch powder (White pepper powder) ¼ tsp or to taste

items.item: Hara pyaz (Green onion) white part julienne
items.raw: Hara pyaz (Green onion) white part julienne 1 Cup
Hara pyaz (Green onion) leaves julienne 1 Cup
Namak (Salt) ¼ tsp or to taste
Safed mirch powder (White pepper powder) ½ tsp or to taste

steps.instruction: Cut beef undercut into thin strips & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Beef undercut ko thin strips mein cut ker lein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In bowl,add egg,corn flour,salt,white pepper powder,soy sauce and whisk well.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein anda,corn flour,namak,safed mirch powder aur soy sauce dal ker ache tarhan whisk ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add beef slices,mix well and marinate for 15 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Beef slices dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur 15 minutes kliya marinate ker lein.

steps.instruction: In wok,heat cooking oil and fry marinated beef until light golden (4-5 minutes) & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Karhai mein cooking oil garam karein aur marinated beef ko light golden hunay tak fry ker lein (4-5 minutes) & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In wok,add cooking oil,garlic and mix.
steps.romanUrdu: Karhai mein cooking oil aur lehsan dal ker mix karein.

steps.instruction: Add oyster sauce,hot sauce and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Oyster sauce aur hot sauce dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add tabasco sauce,soy sauce and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Tabasco sauce aur soy sauce dal ker ache tarhan mix karein.

steps.instruction: Now add fried beef and mix.
steps.romanUrdu: Ab fried beef dal ker mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add onion,green onion white part,green onion leaves,ginger,green chilies and give it a good mix.
steps.romanUrdu: Pyaz,hara pyaz white part,hara pyaz leaves,adark aur hari mirch dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add salt,sugar,white pepper powder and mix well & serve!
steps.romanUrdu: Namak,cheeni aur safed mirch powder dal ker ache tarhan mix karein & serve karein!

ogDescription: The perfect restaurant quality beef chili recipe for you today. Now make it at home and enjoy. #HappyCookingToYou
